implementation_notes: JMH is the only credible microbenchmark harness; without it results are noise. For real workloads use async-profiler and JFR, and read GC logs — allocation rate is usually the story. Prefer `IntStream`/arrays over boxing collections in hot loops.
idiom_name: JMH for microbenchmarks + JFR/async-profiler for profiles
pitfalls: A hand-rolled nanoTime loop instead of JMH
Trusting a profile taken without the JVM warmed up
Assuming a JIT-visible change was actually applied
